data.narrative:
Vector Defense is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $61M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI) alongside 2 public defense technology peers, supplemented by a broader set of 8 private frontier-defense firms.

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from total capital raised, implying $122M. Peer-median comparison across the 4-company Defense & Security Series A cohort yields $700M, with individual comparables ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The peer set exhibits substantial dispersion, reflecting heterogeneity in market positioning and funding momentum within the frontier-defense category.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $104M to $805M, with a median estimate of $411M. The wide spread reflects two structural uncertainties: the significant variance among direct peer valuations—a 32x spread from floor to ceiling—and the early-stage nature of the cohort, where revenue traction and path-to-scale remain differentiating factors. The stage-progression floor ($104M) sits near capital raised; the peer median ($411M) represents the central tendency of the comparable set. Further narrowing would require data on Vector Defense's revenue, customer concentration, and relative technical differentiation within the cohort.
